nodes.summary: The additive structure of sets in integers and abelian groups: sumsets and inverse theorems, sum-product growth, Sidon sets and difference sets, sum-free sets, additive bases, zero-sum problems, and arithmetic progressions in dense sets; colouring (Ramsey-type) versions go to Ramsey theory.
nodes.title: Additive combinatorics

nodes.summary: Binomial, multinomial and generalized binomial coefficients and closed-form evaluation of finite sums built from them (alternating, reciprocal, harmonic-weighted, hypergeometric), including Apéry-like sequences such as Franel, Domb and Zagier numbers; q-binomials go to symmetric functions and q-analogues, Catalan-type numbers to Catalan numbers, Stirling-weighted sums to Stirling numbers.
nodes.title: Binomial coefficients and identities

nodes.summary: Functions from {0,1}^n to {0,1}: counting monotone, self-dual and unate Boolean functions and Dedekind numbers, enumeration of k-SAT functions, noise stability and juntas, and parity and small-bias counts over finite fields.
nodes.title: Boolean functions

nodes.summary: The Catalan family of counting sequences and the lattice paths they count: Catalan, Fuss–Catalan, Narayana, Motzkin, Schröder, Fine and Riordan numbers, Dyck and Motzkin paths and their statistics, Delannoy numbers and walks with prescribed steps, including arithmetic properties (parity, integrality, perfect powers) of these numbers.
nodes.title: Catalan numbers and lattice paths

nodes.summary: Finite and infinite words over finite alphabets: repetitions and avoidability, morphic and Sturmian words, factor complexity, automatic and regular sequences, Lyndon and primitive words, and integer sequences defined by self-description or self-generation.
nodes.title: Combinatorics on words

nodes.summary: Block designs, Steiner systems, pairwise balanced designs and linear spaces, Latin squares and transversals, Hadamard and partial Hadamard matrices, magic squares, 0-1 matrices with prescribed margins (Gale–Ryser), binary matrices up to rotation, and sign tables from determinant-moment expansions; cyclic difference sets go to Sidon sets and difference sets.
nodes.title: Designs, Latin squares and combinatorial matrices

nodes.summary: How evenly a set system, matrix or vector family can be two-coloured: matrix and vector discrepancy, the Komlós and Beck–Fiala problems, hereditary discrepancy, vector balancing, balanced weighted colourings and balancing infinite families.
nodes.title: Discrepancy theory

nodes.summary: Counting basic objects under simple constraints: subsets, multisets and functions with prescribed values, Schreier-type and weighted Schreier sets, combinations avoiding given differences, necklaces and counting up to rotation, fibre and double counting, introductory catalogues of special counting sequences, and small extremal puzzles such as the bridge and torch problem.
nodes.title: Elementary enumeration

nodes.summary: Largest or smallest families of finite sets under intersection, union or containment constraints, and hypergraphs (uniform set systems) studied by Turán, colouring, matching and covering parameters; problems about graphs go to GraphTheory.
nodes.title: Extremal set theory and hypergraphs

nodes.summary: Ordered sums of positive integers: compositions with restricted, palindromic, colored or n-color parts, Arndt compositions, perfect compositions, shade, symmetric peaks and valleys, and convolution identities for weighted compositions.
nodes.title: Integer compositions

nodes.summary: Partitions of integers as combinatorial objects: identities equating partition counts and their bijective proofs, Young diagrams and partition statistics, and counting partitions; congruences for partition functions and theta- or eta-quotient identities go to NumberTheory.
nodes.title: Integer partitions

nodes.summary: Matroids and their invariants: algebraic matroids, Edmonds' intersection and partition theorems, Rado's theorem, characteristic polynomials and log-concavity, the Mason conjectures, Lorentzian polynomials, and lines in weighted matroids.
nodes.title: Matroid theory

nodes.summary: Parking functions and their variants (partial, weakly increasing, k-Naples, metered) and statistics on them: lucky cars, descents, displacement, and lucky statistics of Stirling permutations read as parking preferences.
nodes.title: Parking functions

nodes.summary: Finite posets as combinatorial objects: Dilworth's and Mirsky's theorems, Erdős–Szekeres monotone subsequences, linear extensions, Möbius algebras and flag vectors, chain polynomials and Neggers' conjecture, Sperner properties of the weak order, rowmotion and toggle homomesy, poset matrices and rooted trees; lattice theory goes to Order.
nodes.title: Partially ordered sets

nodes.summary: Permutations of a finite set as combinatorial objects: pattern containment and avoidance, and statistics and cycle structure; descent-counting numbers go to Eulerian numbers, Stirling cycle numbers to Stirling numbers.
nodes.title: Permutations

nodes.summary: Face numbers and h-vectors of simplicial spheres and polytopes (Dehn–Sommerville, upper bound theorem), Cohen–Macaulay, partitionable and interval-decomposable complexes, simplicial homology, Ehrhart polynomials, h*-vectors and the integer decomposition property, lattice parallelograms, and hyperplane arrangements.
nodes.title: Polytopes, Ehrhart theory and simplicial complexes

nodes.summary: Probabilistic methods and random discrete structures outside random graphs: the Lovász local lemma, Littlewood–Offord and Tomaszewski anti-concentration for signed sums, concentration of subset sums, the isolation lemma, thresholds and expectation thresholds, random k-SAT thresholds, perfect matchings in random hypergraphs, the Chvátal–Sankoff constant for longest common subsequences, and moment-based counting…
nodes.title: Probabilistic combinatorics

nodes.summary: Unavoidable monochromatic structure under finite colourings of integers, words, sets and semigroups; graph and ordered-graph Ramsey problems go to GraphTheory, ordinal and infinite-cardinal partition relations to SetTheory, density statements without colouring to additive combinatorics.
nodes.title: Ramsey theory

nodes.summary: Infinite lower-triangular arrays and operators on sequences studied through generating functions: the Riordan group, number triangles and their diagonals, binomial, INVERT and Catalan transforms, Hankel and Toeplitz determinants and continued fractions; a specific named family (Motzkin triangle, Stirling matrices) stays with that family.
nodes.title: Riordan arrays and sequence transforms

nodes.summary: Partitions of a finite set into blocks: finite partition API, ordered and cyclic set partitions, restricted-growth words, peaks and rises, noncrossing partitions, merging-free and marriageable-singles partitions, genus of a partition, and linear chord diagrams and hypermonopoles.
nodes.title: Set partitions

nodes.summary: The number triangles and sequences that count set partitions, permutations by cycles, descents and excedances, and their relatives: Stirling and Lah numbers and their generalizations, Bell and Fubini numbers and Bell polynomials, Eulerian numbers and polynomials, and Bernoulli, Euler and Genocchi numbers studied combinatorially.
nodes.title: Stirling, Bell and Eulerian numbers

nodes.summary: Algebraic combinatorics of symmetric functions and Young tableaux, Gaussian binomial coefficients and other q-analogues, alternating sign matrices and plane partitions (q-TSPP, Robbins numbers), Coxeter–Catalan positivity, chromatic symmetric functions, minuscule polynomials, and positivity or real-rootedness of permanents and gamma vectors.
nodes.title: Symmetric functions, tableaux and q-analogues

nodes.summary: Covering and placement problems on lattices and boards: domino and lozenge tilings and perfect matchings of grid regions (Aztec diamonds, Möbius grids, cylinders and tori), polyominoes and polycubes, tilings of groups by translates and the periodic tiling conjecture, nonattacking chess pieces, rook and file placements on Ferrers boards, and self-avoiding walks on lattices.
nodes.title: Tilings, dimers and board placements

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
